attributes.action: Lascelles house Clifton rd Vs Slough coucil
attributes.additional_details:
Not only are cars getting damaged so is the building and maybe causing structural damage? This problem has been ongoing for years. 
When you enter the porch driveway you have to turn the car around first to try to enter it but if no parking bays were there people wouldn’t need to do this. There needs to be double yellow line opposite the building instead of parking bays. Also the flats need a parking bollard to stop the general public from using it, and taking tenants spaces.
attributes.background: Down Clifton Road, in slough, there is marked parking bays, opposite the turning to the flats, and it is a enclosed driveway through a porch, and it is hard to turn into it if there is a car parked opposite causing a obstruction and everyone damages their cars. Clifton road is a dead end road.

rejection.details: This is a matter for the relevant local authority, not for central government or for Parliament.
